title: Pricing Note on the Negotiated Discount in Retroactive Claim Spend (Crestline Corporate Travel Agreements)
content:
**Note.** A ticket the company booked without its Crestline Corporate Travel Agreements agreement was not discounted at booking. When such a ticket is claimed retroactively, the negotiated discount that booking under the agreement would have applied reduces the claim spend. The fare brand and the route class are those on the claimed ticket's record in Crestline Tickets by Fare Brand.

| Claimed ticket's fare brand | Claimed ticket's route class | Discount percentage |
|---|---|---|
| among the tier's discount-eligible fare brands | long-haul international | the tier's international discount percentage |
| among the tier's discount-eligible fare brands | domestic or short-haul international | the tier's domestic discount percentage |
| not among them | any | none |

**Effect on the claim.** The claim spend is the shared base fare multiplied by one hundred less the discount percentage, divided by one hundred, rounded to the cent. The claim points are then that claim spend multiplied by the tier's points per dollar, rounded down to the whole point.

### The tier figures

| Tier | Domestic and short-haul international (percent) | Long-haul international (percent) | Discount-eligible fare brands |
|---|---|---|---|
| Crestline Business Connect | 0 | 0 | none |
| Crestline Business Connect Plus | 3 | 5 | Crestline Main Cabin, Crestline Main Plus |
| Crestline Corporate Select | 5 | 8 | Crestline Main Cabin, Crestline Main Plus, Crestline Main Flexible |
| Crestline Corporate Preferred | 8 | 10 | the Select brands and Crestline Premium Economy |
| Crestline Corporate Premier | 12 | 14 | the Preferred brands and Crestline First |
| Crestline Corporate Strategic | 15 | 18 | the Preferred brands and Crestline First |

### Worked claims (hypothetical shared base fare of USD 350.00)

- Crestline Corporate Select, Crestline Main Cabin, long-haul international: 350.00 multiplied by 92 and divided by one hundred gives a claim spend of USD 322.00; at 1.5 points per dollar the claim points are 483.
- Crestline Corporate Select, Crestline Main Cabin, domestic: 350.00 multiplied by 95 and divided by one hundred gives USD 332.50.
- Crestline Corporate Select, Crestline Premium Economy, long-haul international: the brand is not on the Select list, so the claim spend stays USD 350.00.
